notes: Art & heritage concepts for Signs Around You. Verse keys were checked with prep/scripts/match_inscription.py helpers against KFGQPC v18 on 2026-10-02. Every card text needs an approved source and sharia sign-off before publishing.

concepts.card: What Arabic calligraphy is; the main scripts (Kufic, Naskh, Thuluth, Diwani, Maghribi, Nastaliq) shown as "Looks like: Thuluth" tiers, never as certainty.
concepts.flow: Transcribe the text (vision, structured tokens + uncertain flags) -> match_inscription.py -> exact: show canonical verse + approved translation; near: show the real verse and the difference; none: "not a Quranic verse we can identify".
concepts.level: A for matched verses; style notes are historical (non-sharia) and need an academic source
